questions.question: In an industrial petrochemical steam cracker, what type of temperature sensor is standardly specified for radiant coil tube-skin monitoring up to 1100°C?

options.text: Type K or Type N specialized sheath Thermocouple

questions.correct_answer: Type K or Type N specialized sheath Thermocouple
questions.explanation: Petrochemical furnace tubes operate between 900°C and 1150°C. RTDs degrade above 600°C-850°C. Heavy-wall Inconel-sheathed Type K (Chromel-Alumel) or Type N (Nicrosil-Nisil) thermocouples with knife-edge weld pads are the industrial standard.

questions.question: In an EPC automation project, what safety integrity level architecture standard requires dual redundant 1oo2D or 2oo3 voting for critical emergency shutdown (ESD) valves?
questions.explanation: IEC 61508 and sector standard IEC 61511 govern functional safety of safety instrumented systems (SIS) in process industries. SIL-3 requirements commonly dictate 1oo2D or 2oo3 redundant voting architectures.

questions.question: In a computational sorting workflow of n sensor log packets, what is the worst-case asymptotic time complexity of standard Merge Sort?
questions.explanation: Merge Sort uses a divide-and-conquer strategy: log2(n) division levels with linear O(n) merging work per level. Its best, average, and worst-case time complexities are all strictly O(n log n).
